_design.scope: Security headers + CORS scoped to /api/* only. NO CORS constraints on regular pages.
_design.cors_strategy: Access-Control-Allow-Origin is restricted to the canonical BrightAI domain ONLY for /api/* routes. Static pages are not affected.
_design.csp_strategy: Phase 1 (this deploy): removed unused third-party domains from the allowlist. unsafe-inline retained because Astro layouts/components use <script is:inline> for GA/Clarity init and Kernel pages. Phase 2 (next): nonce-based CSP with per-request nonce in BaseLayout (requires Astro 5+ middleware).
_design.hsts_strategy: max-age=63072000 (2 years) per request. includeSubDomains; preload. Preload submission via https://hstspreload.org is a manual one-time action after this deploy.
